name: Logo Wall
description: Arrange a pile of logos into a clean, even sponsor grid - the “NASCAR” wall.

examples.label: Tiered sponsor wall of placeholder wordmarks, in the brand ink

fields.label: Presence
fields.help: How prominent this logo is. Balancing equalises everyone first; Presence then deliberately weights this one up or down - sponsor-tier sizing.

fields.label: Size %
fields.help: Fine nudge on top of Presence and balancing.

fields.label: Render as vector
fields.help: Flatten this logo to the single ink colour (crisp vector). Off keeps it as its original image.

fields.label: Tune this logo
fields.help: Give this logo its own vector settings - for finnicky marks that need a different threshold or inverting.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Brightness cut-off for this logo. Higher keeps more of it.

fields.label: Invert
fields.help: For a white or pale logo.

fields.label: Tier
fields.help: Group logos by sponsor level. Logos with the same tier sit together in their own rows, in the order each tier first appears, under that tier as a heading. Leave every tier empty for one even grid.

inputs.label: Columns
inputs.help: How many logos sit in each row. At another canvas size, such as a tall 1080 x 1920 or an A4 page, the wall puts fewer or more in each row to fill that shape.

inputs.label: Horizontal spacing
inputs.help: Gap between logos across a row.

inputs.label: Horizontal padding
inputs.help: Breathing room on the left and right of the wall.

inputs.label: Vertical padding
inputs.help: Breathing room above and below the wall.

inputs.label: Tier headings
inputs.help: Show each tier's name above its group of logos. Only applies when logos have a tier.

inputs.label: Tier sizes
inputs.help: Step down puts one more logo in a row for each tier below the first, so higher tiers read larger. Same size gives every tier the Columns setting. Presence, Size % and Balance sizes still apply to each logo.

inputs.label: Heading colour
inputs.help: The colour of the tier headings.

inputs.label: Balance sizes
inputs.help: Auto-size each logo by its optical weight - heavier logos shrink, lighter ones grow - so the wall reads as evenly weighted. Each logo's own Size % still applies on top. Turn off for uniform sizing.

inputs.label: Trim margins
inputs.help: Crop each logo to its artwork - transparent or flat-colour margins are measured away (SVGs included, still fully vector), and each logo then fits its cell by real content. Turn off if a logo's clear-space padding is deliberate.

inputs.label: Remove white backgrounds
inputs.help: A logo lifted from an old slide or screenshot usually arrives in a solid white box. This makes that near-white backing transparent so the logo sits directly on the wall - coloured tiles and white inside the mark itself are kept. Needs Trim margins on.

inputs.label: Render all as vector
inputs.help: Flatten the whole wall to the single ink colour below. SVG logos are recoloured losslessly; image logos are traced to crisp paths. Each logo can also opt in individually in its block.

inputs.label: Ink colour
inputs.help: The single ink for any logo rendered as vector.

inputs.label: Threshold
inputs.help: Default brightness cut-off for traced logos. Higher keeps more of each logo; tune a finnicky one per logo in its block.

inputs.label: Invert
inputs.help: Swap which side of the threshold becomes ink. White / pale logos are auto-inverted, so you rarely need this; tune per logo if one needs it.

inputs.label: Detail
inputs.help: Minimum tracing resolution. The trace automatically samples finer than the source image where that gains precision; raise this only if fine shapes still drop out.

inputs.label: Smoothing
inputs.help: How much traced outlines round into curves. Low keeps edges crisp; high flows them into smooth Bézier curves.

inputs.label: Repeat
inputs.help: Tile the whole logo set to fill a backdrop - the press-wall treatment behind interviews and event photos. Grid stacks rows squarely, Brick offsets alternate rows by half a cell, Checker staggers logos diagonally with space between.

inputs.label: Rows
inputs.help: How many rows the repeated wall stacks. Logos keep cycling in order, so neighbouring repeats stay varied. At another canvas size the wall stacks fewer or more rows to fill that shape.
